name: Tax Amount 2
definition: Set of elements used to provide information on the tax amount(s) of tax record.

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: Rate used to calculate the tax.

TaxableBaseAmount.name: Taxable Base Amount
TaxableBaseAmount.definition: Amount of money on which the tax is based.

TotalAmount.name: Total Amount
TotalAmount.definition: Total amount that is the result of the calculation of the tax for the record.

Details.name: Details
Details.definition: Set of elements used to provide details on the tax period and amount.
